en: CryptoAID is a support, education and security-oriented ecosystem for crypto/Web3 users.
it: CryptoAID è un ecosistema orientato a supporto, educazione e sicurezza per utenti crypto/Web3.

en: CryptoAID support must never ask for your seed phrase, private key, password or 2FA code.
it: Il supporto CryptoAID non deve mai chiederti seed phrase, chiave privata, password o codice 2FA.

en: Blockchain tracing can support investigation, but it does not by itself guarantee recovery of funds.
it: Il tracing blockchain può supportare un'indagine, ma da solo non garantisce il recupero dei fondi.

en: Official website: https://cryptoaid.support — Channel: https://t.me/cryptoaidsup — Community: https://t.me/cryptoAIDsupporter
it: Sito ufficiale: https://cryptoaid.support — Canale: https://t.me/cryptoaidsup — Community: https://t.me/cryptoAIDsupporter
